open_obligations.what_is_open: For fixed indices admitting strict density and Bernoulli marked-channel Sobolev slack, construct the moment-annihilating packet with the required Bernoulli range and \(K_n^{1/2-\beta}\) supremum separation, and prove a weighted chi-square or Hellinger bound strong enough to give product total variation below some \(\eta<1-2\alpha\).
open_obligations.obstruction: Primitive compatibility certifies that \(\mathcal M\) and \(\mathscr K\) are nonempty, but it does not certify the strictly interior Bernoulli submodel demanded by the OEQ. In particular, \(1/4\le b_x\) forces \(\|f_xb_x\|_{H^\beta}\ge(4\sqrt{2B_A})^{-1}\), whereas the compatible range permits any \(R_q>0\). Even after imposing strict nuisance slack, the frozen core has no weighted observed-density lower envelope that converts factorial Fourier attenuation into the requested product-experiment divergence bound.
open_obligations.attempted: The explicit reference bump and asymmetric centered two-point errors were used to certify ordinary model inhabitation. For the lower experiment, moment annihilation was propagated through the exact marked-channel factorization, producing factorial attenuation on a fixed frequency square. A direct norm calculation then isolated why this does not establish the required strict Bernoulli interior or the product-Hellinger control.

prose_updates.tldr: The primary contribution remains statistical inference over an explicitly compatible, nonempty fixed class. Identification is enabling: a marked analytic cocycle identifies the latent density and outcome-weighted channel, while the structural response surface derives conditional ignorability, simultaneous schedule boundedness, observed-outcome boundedness, and the continuous-representative marked envelope. The finite-dimensional, semi-infinite constrained-sieve band is uniformly honest, clipped to \(0\le W_n\le2B_Y\), and has uniformly \(o(1)\) expected maximal width; a parallel abstract exact-class band has the same qualitative conclusion. No finite decision algorithm, explicit \(O(r_n)\) rate, minimax match, or unconditional converse is claimed, and the fixed-nuisance Bernoulli modulus remains open.

project_justification.gap: Existing results do not provide a quantitative simultaneous ADRF band rate for blind nonidentical asymmetric replicate errors with open spectral zero sets. This paper now certifies that its fixed causal and projected classes are inhabited, but that soundness repair does not close either quantitative gap: the upper side still lacks an explicit protected-cube marked inverse modulus, and the lower side still lacks a strictly interior fixed-nuisance Bernoulli packet and product-divergence bound.
project_justification.niche: The headline is a Stat result rather than a new identification claim: the causal target is identified by an enabling cocycle argument, and the inferential niche is nonvacuous simultaneous whole-curve uncertainty quantification in a nonlinear severe inverse problem. Compact treatment support supplies entire transforms, one centered replicate fixes translation, the moment radius supplies a protected neighborhood, and the structural response surface derives rather than separately assumes ignorability and outcome boundedness. Sobolev moduli convert qualitative channel identification into uniform contraction over compatible fixed indices.
project_justification.fill: A normalized smooth reference bump and two fixed centered, asymmetric, nonidentical two-point error laws explicitly inhabit both the full causal class and the exact projected class. Over that compatible class, the finite-dimensional, semi-infinite deterministic construction profiles simultaneous probability, marked, and mass restrictions over equicontinuous relaxed signal sieves and atomic error sieves; its expected maximal width is at most \(\widetilde\omega_n+2b_{\mu,n}+2B_Y|\mathcal X|e^{-np_{\min}/8}=o(1)\). A parallel abstract exact-class profile has the same qualitative coverage and contraction conclusion. Neither construction supplies a finite decision algorithm or an explicit rate.

sampling_model.design: The data are an i.i.d. sample of marked blind two-replicate observations \(O_i=(Y_i,X_i,S_{i1},S_{i2})\). The fixed indices satisfy an explicit primitive compatibility condition, and a constructed product law proves that the causal and exact projected classes are nonempty; identification remains an enabling step for the focal uniformly honest simultaneous band.
sampling_model.units: Superpopulation units have nonempty finite-stratum \(X_i\), compact latent dose \(A_i\), and potential-outcome schedules generated simultaneously as \(Y_i(a)=h(a,X_i,V_i)\) by a jointly measurable response surface with \(V_i\perp A_i\mid X_i\). This retained structure derives continuous-treatment ignorability and bounds the entire schedule on one common full-probability event; the stratum-specific causal means are continuous on \(I\).
sampling_model.treatment: The replicates satisfy \(S_{i1}=A_i+U_{i1}\) and \(S_{i2}=A_i+U_{i2}\). The errors are independent, need not be identically distributed or symmetric, may have open spectral zero sets, obey a fixed \(q_e>1\) moment radius, and use only \(E[U_2]=0\) to fix location. Their protected near-zero modulus is derived from the moment bound rather than imposed separately.
sampling_model.overlap: The target interval obeys \(f_x(a)\ge\kappa\) for every \(x\in\mathcal X\) and \(a\in I\). Primitive compatibility requires \(0<\kappa\le\kappa_0\), where \(\kappa_0\) is the reference bump's positive minimum on the compact interior interval, so this restriction is jointly feasible with the density radius.
sampling_model.nuisance_estimation: The finite-dimensional, semi-infinite deterministic profiling construction uses relaxed order-\(d\) B-spline families for \(f_x,q_x\), intersected with deterministic Sobolev-modulus inequalities, finite atomic characteristic-function families for both errors, and \(p_x\in\mathcal P_{n,\alpha}\) against simultaneous empirical probability- and marked-channel restrictions on \(\mathcal D_n\). The continuum inequalities are imposed exactly, so no finite decision algorithm is claimed. A second abstract construction profiles the same empirical radii over the exact compact projected class \(\mathscr K\).
sampling_model.tails: The structural response surface takes values in \([-B_Y,B_Y]\), which derives simultaneous schedule boundedness and, by consistency, \(|Y|\le B_Y\); bounded outcomes are not a separate primitive assumption. Each measurement error has a fixed \(q_e>1\) absolute-moment bound \(M_e\).

prose_updates.related_work: The organizing cluster is statistical inference rather than exact identification: the cocycle result enables the focal honest-band theorem over an explicitly compatible and inhabited fixed class. Capitao-Miniconi, Gassiat, and Lehéricy provide the unmarked probability-channel cocycle and compact-support density analysis that inform this paper. Their Theorem 1 assumes coordinate independence for the noise and condition H2 for the signal; compact support places the present probability signal inside H2 with \(\rho=1\). The present unmarked probability submodel is contained in their normalized scalar signal-identification setting, but is stricter because it additionally fixes error moments and centers \(U_2\); their theorem also identifies error laws up to translation, whereas the present marked theorem claims only \(f_x,q_x\). Their rate and minimax theorems add second-moment and protected-frequency conditions and concern \(L^2\) density risk, so those rates do not imply an ADRF supremum-band rate. Gassiat, Le Corff, and Lehéricy supply the broader analytic-continuation principle for blind deconvolution. Huang and Zhang formulate the error-contaminated continuous-treatment ADRF and derive pointwise inference with a known everywhere-nonzero error transform. Kato and Sasaki (2018) develop deconvolution bands with an auxiliary error sample and a symmetric-error repeated-measurement route; Kato and Sasaki (2019) establish uniform bands under conventional spectral conditions. Kato, Sasaki, and Ura invert Kotlarski restrictions without completeness. Babii studies honest expected diameter for fixed linear inverse operators. Hoffmann and Nickl \cite{HoffmannNickl2011} and Bull \cite{Bull2012} study adaptive direct-problem bands, whereas the present theorem fixes \(\beta,R_f,R_q\) and claims no adaptation. Andrews and Mikusheva \cite{AndrewsMikusheva2020} establish impossibility phenomena along nearly unidentified sequences; the present compatible fixed class obtains only qualitative contraction and does not cover drifting weak-identification regimes. Low supplies a testing-to-expected-length reduction only after a marked modulus is established. The new inhabitation witness repairs model soundness but does not supply the missing quantitative inverse or lower packet.
prose_updates.interpretation: The observed two-channel law identifies the continuous quotient \(q_x/f_x\). The jointly measurable structural response surface derives \(A\perp Y(a)\mid X\) and bounds the whole potential-outcome schedule on one event; positivity and continuity then connect the observed quotient to every target dose. The normalized bump and asymmetric two-point errors show that these restrictions are jointly satisfiable. Sobolev moduli prevent increasingly oscillatory feasible signals and turn expanding-grid channel agreement into qualitative whole-curve contraction. The Melaku--Shi (2026) two-recall diet--mortality analysis \cite{MelakuShi2026} is motivation only; coverage applies insofar as its law satisfies the stated compatibility, support, overlap, structural-response, moment, and smoothness conditions.
prose_updates.technical_internal_limitation: The causal bridge, model inhabitation, analytic-cocycle identification, simultaneous transform concentration, equicontinuous outer-sieve embedding, clipped uniform coverage, and qualitative finite-sieve contraction are proved. Compactness shows \(\widetilde\omega_n\to0\) but supplies no numerical inverse modulus. Primitive compatibility guarantees a zero-response inhabitant, not the strict Bernoulli marked-channel Sobolev interior needed for the fixed-nuisance lower experiment; for example, \(1/4\le b_x\) forces \(\|f_xb_x\|_{H^\beta}\ge(4\sqrt{2B_A})^{-1}\). Even in a strict-interior subregime, the packet and weighted product-divergence argument remain open.
prose_updates.honest_scope: The fixed class is explicitly compatible and nonempty. It has nonempty finite strata, compact dose support, overlap with \(0<\kappa\le\kappa_0\), density radius \(R_f\ge R_{f,0}\), positive marked radius, Sobolev smoothness \(\beta>1/2\), and an error moment radius with \(q_e>1\). A bounded structural response surface and consistency derive, rather than separately assume, schedule and observed-outcome boundedness; the same structure derives ignorability. No separate spectral-modulus restriction is imposed. For all sufficiently large \(n\), the finite-dimensional, semi-infinite outer-sieve band is uniformly honest, has width at most \(2B_Y\), and has uniformly \(o(1)\) expected maximal width; the exact-class band is a parallel abstract construction. No finite decision algorithm, explicit \(O(r_n)\) rate, minimax match, rate elbow, or unconditional converse is claimed.
